text: Web sessions die with the browser tab; no server-side session expiry at all

Implemented and verified across all three components; shipping in 1.6.0.

Server: auth_tokens.idle_ttl_ms (migration 3) + resolve_idle_ttl_ms() mapping the
login "platform" hint to a window (web 7d / android 62d, long default when absent).
Enforced in require_account (401 session_expired, row deleted on sight) and swept
by gc.run; list_sessions hides expired rows.

Web: token + account moved to localStorage; sends platform "web".
Android: sends platform "android".
Both clients render per-session last activity (last_seen_at was already on the wire).

Verified: full verify-all green (server 257 / web 120 / android 270 + lint), and the
migration checked end-to-end against a DB built from the real v1.5.0 schema —
auto-applies on connect, stamps user_version 3, backfills device_label='web' to 7d
and everything else to 62d.
